entries.ae9b6186c195f617: General Staffing and Engineer Dispatch Business
entries.d4c8657f98c30520: A business specializing in engineer dispatch, mainly sending technical professionals called 'technologists' with specialized skills to the development and design departments of manufacturers, centered on four fields: mechanical design, electrical and electronic design, software development and architectural design. In addition to staffing contracts, it also enters into contracting and outsourcing agreements. It runs this business from seven sales offices in Japan, and its consolidated subsidiary JTEC Advanced Technology Co., Ltd. also undertakes it. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,358 million, accounting for all of consolidated revenue.
